displayName: OCI-AI-PI-003: AI — System Prompt Extraction Attempt
description:
Detects attempts to extract system prompts through direct questioning, translation, or format manipulation

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_pi_003", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%system%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%prompt%') AND "value" > 0
